svg.title: ETL owns match facts
svg.desc: Stream Analytics writes events, key events and stats to Azure SQL; Data API builder serves GraphQL; Service Bus carries notifications.. What exists now, with its status.
svg.text: The backend selects and delivers standard stats; ETL calculates them, on SPADL actions.
Tested locally (SQL Server + DAB containers, etl-stream with the same rules); deployed on Azure (23 Oct).
A restored seed fed only what follows writes the same rows as one uninterrupted run.
NOW · Solid: data / calls · Dashed: messages · Green: deployed on Azure (23 Oct) · Blue: tested locally · Amber tag: DEMO_SEEDS adapter (demo build only)
